ModMetaData.name: EDF Rim
ModMetaData.author: mfmfwolf
ModMetaData.description:
EDF deploy! This mod adds EDF to the Rimworld world. RDF for Rimworld Defense Force? EDF is surely cooler.
Pleasant friendlies, helpless civilians, incompetent command centers, useless air forces... they have a lot of things to protect, but buildings don't seem to be included in that list.
